m2m100.text: این مشتری بدون صدا اجرا می شود (بدون کمک رسانه ای): اگر همبستگی صدا (یک مرورگر) ارائه می دهد، تماس به پایان می رسد و شما به idle باز می گردید. دو مشتری ترمینال می توانند در یک تماس بمانند تا زمان ها و رای های تمدید را امتحان کنند.
m2m100.back_translation: This client runs without sound (without media assistance): If the sound synergy (one browser) provides, the call ends and you return to the idle. Two terminal customers can stay in one call to try the time and votes for renewal.

madlad-400.text: این کارخواه بدون صدا اجرا می‌شود (بدون کمک رسانه): اگر همتا صدا را ارائه دهد (مرورگر)، تماس پایان می‌یابد و شما به حالت بی‌کار برمی‌گردید. دو کارخواه پایانه می‌توانند در تماس باقی بمانند تا زمان‌سنج‌ها و رای‌های افزونه را امتحان کنند.
madlad-400.back_translation: This client will run silently (without media assistance): If the peer (browser) provides audio, the call will end and you will return to idle mode. The two terminal clients can remain connected to test timers and plug-in voices.

opus-mt.text: این کلاینت بدون صدا اجرا می شود (بدون کمک کننده رسانه ای): اگر همتا صوتی (یک مرورگر) را ارائه دهد، تماس به پایان می رسد و شما به بیکار می روید. دو کلاینت ترمینال می توانند در یک تماس برای امتحان تایمر و رای افزونه باقی بمانند.
opus-mt.back_translation: This thing is set in motion without a voice: if the trumpet gives a voice, it is ended, and you go in vain; two kinds of trumpet are kept to the test in one time, and they have no increase.

translategemma-4b.text: این مشتری بدون صدا کار می‌کند (بدون هیچ کمک رسانه): اگر طرف مقابل صدا داشته باشد (مثلاً یک مرورگر)، تماس قطع می‌شود و شما به حالت انتظار باز می‌گردید. دو مشتری می‌توانند در یک تماس با هدف آزمایش تایمرها و رای‌های افزونه، باقی بمانند.

madlad-400.text: Ang client na ito ay tumatakbo nang walang audio (walang media helper): kung nag-aalok ang peer ng audio (isang browser), ang tawag ay nagtatapos at bumalik ka sa idle. Dalawang terminal client ay maaaring manatili sa isang tawag upang subukan ang mga timer at extension boto.
madlad-400.back_translation: This client runs without audio (no media helper): if the peer offers audio (a browser), the call ends and you return to idle. Two terminal clients can remain on a call to test timers and vote extensions.

opus-mt.text: Ang kliyenteng ito ay tumatakbo nang walang audio (walang tagatulong sa media): kung ang kasamahan ay nag-aalok ng audio (isang browser), ang tawag ay natatapos at ikaw ay bumabalik sa walang ginagawa.Ang dalawang mga kliyenteng terminal ay maaaring manatili sa isang tawag upang subukan ang mga timer at karagdagang boto.
opus-mt.back_translation: This client runs without audio (no media helper): if the colleague offers audio (a browser), the call ends and you return to idle work. The two terminal clients may stay in a call to try timers and additional votes.

translategemma-12b.text: Ang kliyenteng ito ay gumagana nang walang audio (walang media helper). Kung ang kabilang partido ay nag-aalok ng audio (halimbawa, sa pamamagitan ng isang browser), ang tawag ay magtatapos at babalik ka sa estado ng paghihintay. Dalawang kliyente sa terminal ay maaaring manatili sa isang tawag upang subukan ang mga timer at mga boto para sa mga extension.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This client operates without audio (no media helper). If the other party offers audio (for example, through a browser), the call will terminate, and you will return to the waiting state. Two clients on the same terminal can remain in a call to test timers and voting mechanisms for extensions.

translategemma-4b.text: Ang kliyenteng ito ay gumagana nang walang audio (walang tulong sa media): kung ang kasama ay nag-aalok ng audio (tulad ng isang browser), ang tawag ay magtatapos at babalik ka sa estado ng paghihintay. Dalawang kliyenteng terminal ay maaaring manatili sa isang tawag upang subukan ang mga timer at boto para sa pagpapalawig.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: This client functions without audio (no media support): If a companion offers audio (such as a browser), the call will end and you will return to the waiting state. Two client terminals can remain on a call to test timers and voting for extension.

strings.key: This client is running without audio (no media helper): if the peer offers audio (a browser), the call ends and you go back to idle. Two terminal clients can stay in a call to try timers and extension votes.
strings.msgid: This client is running without audio (no media helper): if the peer offers audio (a browser), the call ends and you go back to idle. Two terminal clients can stay in a call to try timers and extension votes.
strings.best_why: best of 6 passing translations by MetricX-24 and COMET-Kiwi
strings.best_text: Klien ini beroperasi tanpa audio (tidak menggunakan modul pendukung media). Jika pihak lain menawarkan audio (melalui browser), panggilan akan berakhir dan Anda akan kembali ke keadaan siaga. Dua klien terminal dapat tetap dalam panggilan untuk menguji fitur pengatur waktu dan pemungutan suara ekstensi.

hy-mt2.text: Klien ini berjalan tanpa audio (tanpa media helper): jika pihak lawan menawarkan audio (sebuah browser), panggilan akan berakhir dan Anda kembali ke keadaan idle. Dua klien terminal dapat tetap berada dalam panggilan untuk menguji timer dan pemungutan suara ekstensi.
hy-mt2.back_translation: This client operates without audio (without a media helper): if the other party offers audio (a browser), the call will end and you will return to the idle state. Two terminal clients can remain on a call to test the timer and extension voting.

m2m100.text: Klien ini berjalan tanpa audio (tidak ada pembantu media): jika peer menawarkan audio (browser), panggilan berakhir dan Anda kembali ke idle.
m2m100.back_translation: This client runs without audio (no media assistant): if the peer offers audio (browser), the call ends and you return to the idle.

madlad-400.text: Klien ini berjalan tanpa audio (tidak ada media helper): jika peer menawarkan audio (sebuah peramban), panggilan berakhir dan Anda kembali ke idle. Dua klien terminal dapat tetap berada dalam panggilan untuk mencoba timer dan suara ekstensi.
madlad-400.back_translation: This client is running without audio (no media helper): if the peer offers audio (a browser), the call ends and you return to idle. Two terminal clients may remain in the call to try timer and sound extensions.

opus-mt.text: Klien ini berjalan tanpa audio (tidak ada media pembantu): jika peer menawarkan audio (a browser), panggilan berakhir dan Anda kembali menganggur. Dua klien terminal dapat tetap dalam panggilan untuk mencoba timer dan ekstensi suara.
opus-mt.back_translation: This client runs without audio (no helper media): if peer offers audio (a browser), the call ends and you return unemployed. Two terminal clients can remain in calls to try timer and extended sound.

translategemma-12b.text: Klien ini beroperasi tanpa audio (tidak menggunakan modul pendukung media). Jika pihak lain menawarkan audio (melalui browser), panggilan akan berakhir dan Anda akan kembali ke keadaan siaga. Dua klien terminal dapat tetap dalam panggilan untuk menguji fitur pengatur waktu dan pemungutan suara ekstensi.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This client operates without audio (it does not use any media support modules). If the other party offers audio (through a browser), the call will terminate, and you will return to the standby state. Two terminal clients can remain in a call to test the extension timer and voting features.

translategemma-4b.text: Klien ini berfungsi tanpa audio (tanpa bantuan media): jika satu pihak menawarkan audio (seperti browser), panggilan akan berakhir dan Anda kembali ke keadaan idle. Dua klien terminal dapat tetap berada dalam panggilan untuk mencoba fungsi timer dan suara.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: This client functions without audio (without relying on media): if one party offers audio (such as a browser), the call will end, and you will return to the idle state. Two terminal clients can remain in a call to attempt the timer and audio functions.

Due client terminali possono rimanere in una chiamata per testare i timer e le votazioni delle estensioni.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This client operates without audio capabilities (it has no components for media handling). strings.best_text: このクライアントはオーディオなしで動作しています（メディアヘルパーなし）。もし相手側がオーディオを提供する場合（ブラウザの場合）、通話は終了し、再びアイドル状態に戻ります。2つの端末クライアントは、タイマーや拡張機能の投票を試すために通話を続けることができます。

hy-mt2.text: このクライアントはオーディオなしで動作しています（メディアヘルパーなし）。もし相手側がオーディオを提供する場合（ブラウザの場合）、通話は終了し、再びアイドル状態に戻ります。2つの端末クライアントは、タイマーや拡張機能の投票を試すために通話を続けることができます。
hy-mt2.back_translation: This client operates without audio (without a media helper). If the other party provides audio (in the case of a browser), the call is terminated and it returns to idle state. The two terminal clients can continue the call to test timers and extension voting.

m2m100.text: このクライアントはオーディオなしで実行されます(メディアアシスタントなし):ペアがオーディオ(ブラウザ)を提供している場合、通話は終了し、あなたはアイドルに戻ります。
m2m100.back_translation: This client will run without audio (no media assistant): If the pair provides audio (browser), the call will end and you will return to the idol.

madlad-400.text: このクライアントはオーディオなしで動作しています (メディアヘルパーなし)。ピアがオーディオ (ブラウザ) を提供すると、コールは終了し、あなたはアイドルに戻ります。2 つのターミナルクライアントはコール中に残ってタイマーや拡張ボートを試すことができます。
madlad-400.back_translation: This client is running without audio (no media helper). When the peer provides audio (browser), the call will end and you will return to idle. The two terminal clients can remain in the call to try the timer or the extension boot.

translategemma-12b.text: このクライアントは音声機能なしで動作します（メディアヘルパーは使用していません）。もし相手側が音声機能（ブラウザなど）を提供した場合、通話は終了し、待機状態に戻ります。2つのターミナルクライアントであれば、タイマーや拡張機能のテストのために通話を維持することができます。
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This client operates without audio functionality (it does not use media helpers). m2m100.text: 이 클라이언트는 오디오없이 실행됩니다 (미디어 도우미가 없습니다): 커플이 오디오를 제공하는 경우 (브라우저), 전화가 끝나고 당신은 아이돌로 돌아갑니다.
m2m100.back_translation: This client will run without audio (no media assistant): if the pair provides audio (browser), after the phone ends, you’ll go back to the idol.

madlad-400.back_translation: This client is running without audio (no media helper). When the peer provides audio (browser), the call is terminated and returns to idle. The two terminal clients remain in the call and can attempt timers and extended voting.

If the other party provides audio functionality (e.g., when using a browser), the call will terminate and return to the waiting state. hy-mt2.text: Этот клиент работает без аудио (отсутствует медиа-вспомогательный модуль): если собеседник предлагает аудио (браузер), звонок прерывается, и вы возвращаетесь в режим ожидания. hy-mt2.back_translation: This client works without audio (the media support module is missing): if the caller offers audio (browser), the call is interrupted and you return to the waiting mode. Two terminal clients can remain in the call to test timers and voting extensions.

m2m100.text: Этот клиент работает без аудио (без медиа-помощника): если соперник предлагает аудио (браузер), звонок заканчивается, и вы возвращаетесь к иду.
m2m100.back_translation: This client works without audio (without a media assistant): if the competitor offers audio (browser), the call ends, and you are returning to go.

madlad-400.text: Этот клиент работает без звука (без медиа-помощника): если участник предлагает аудио (браузер), звонок заканчивается и вы возвращаетесь в состояние простоя. Два терминальных клиента могут остаться в звонке, чтобы попробовать таймеры и голосования расширений.
madlad-400.back_translation: This client runs without audio (without media assistant): if a participant offers audio (browser), the call ends and you return to idle state. Two terminal clients can remain in the call to try timers and voting extensions.

opus-mt.text: Этот клиент работает без звука (без помощи средств массовой информации): если участник предлагает аудио (браузер), звонок заканчивается и вы возвращаетесь в пустой режим. Два клиента могут остаться в вызове, чтобы попробовать таймеры и продлить голоса.
opus-mt.back_translation: This client works without sound (without the help of the media): if a participant offers audio (browser), the call ends and you return to empty mode. Two clients may remain on call to try the timers and extend the votes.

translategemma-12b.text: Этот клиент работает без звука (без использования модуля обработки мультимедиа): если другая сторона (например, браузер) предлагает звук, звонок прерывается, и вы возвращаетесь в состояние ожидания. Два клиента, работающие в терминальном режиме, могут оставаться в звонке для тестирования таймеров и голосования по расширениям.
translategemma-12b.back_translation: This client operates without audio (without using the multimedia processing module): if the other party (e.g., a browser) offers audio, the call is interrupted, and you return to the waiting state. Two clients running in terminal mode can remain in the call for testing timers and for voting on extensions.

translategemma-4b.text: Этот клиент работает без звука (без поддержки медиа): если другой клиент предлагает звук (например, через браузер), соединение обрывается, и вы возвращаетесь в состояние ожидания. Два терминальных клиента могут оставаться в соединении для тестирования таймеров и голосования за расширения.
translategemma-4b.back_translation: This client operates without audio (no media support): if another client offers audio (e.g., through a browser), the connection is terminated, and you return to the waiting state. Two terminal clients can remain connected for testing timers and voting on extensions.

opus-mt.back_translation: We count hearts, people: no leaf, no identity, nothing about anyone.

translategemma-4b.back_translation: We are not concerned with the number of people, but rather with the number of accounts. We do not collect or store any personal information, such as addresses, IDs, or other details.
